_comment: Capability-root manifest for iam/ (founder ruling oyatie-0s8). This is the ADR-0562 capability's OWN service manifest, the `<root>/manifest.json` shape that ci/facade/service-tier-metadata treats as top-level. It exists because the capability-first rehome left 68 crates directly under iam/ that belonged to NO manifest: the sub-service manifests under iam/*/manifest.json cover their own services only. Every crate, service and SLO path below was read off the tree, not transcribed.
dr_tier_derivation: Strictest dr_tier declared by any absorbed service of this capability (cloud-iam=T1, consent-graph=T1, identity=T1). The shared crates sit in the failure path of the strictest consumer, so the capability root may not claim a weaker DR class than the service that depends on it.

substrate_dag_position._note: DELIBERATELY NOT S1 OR S3. The ADR-0562 capability-registry lists iam among the nine capabilities whose tier facets are undeclared pending a founder/architecture ruling, on the stated ground that iam SPANS S1+S3: iam/cloud-iam and iam/identity declare S1 while iam/consent-graph declares S3. Picking either value here would settle that ruling by omission from a manifest, so this root forward-declares per ADR-0280 Appendix C (the same class storage/ uses) and the split is recorded in absorbed_service_facet_divergence below.

purpose: Identity and access substrate capability root, and the largest of the five by crate count. The crates directly under iam/ are the capability-level identity, workload-identity/SVID, Cedar policy/PDP and tenant-RBAC model, its port boundaries, its Cedar/OIDC/Postgres-RLS/K8s adapters and its evidence facades. The deployed IAM services (cloud-iam, consent-graph, identity) carry their own manifests and SLOs.

bounded_contexts.name: iam-adapters
bounded_contexts.description: Capability-level driven adapters (storage, transport, provider) under iam/adapters/. Covered by no service manifest before this file existed.

bounded_contexts.name: iam-core
bounded_contexts.description: Capability-level domain / usecase / kernel crates (pure, no I/O) under iam/core/. Covered by no service manifest before this file existed.

bounded_contexts.name: iam-facade
bounded_contexts.description: Capability-level composition, app and evidence crates under iam/facade/. Covered by no service manifest before this file existed.

bounded_contexts.name: iam-ports
bounded_contexts.description: Capability-level port + API boundary crates under iam/ports/. Covered by no service manifest before this file existed.

contracts_non_claim: This capability root serves no endpoint of its own, so all three carrier arrays are EMPTY rather than populated: every OpenAPI, AsyncAPI and proto contract under iam/ belongs to one of the absorbed services listed above and is declared by that service's manifest. The internal_grpc block is present-and-empty, not omitted, because the H2/proto3 posture binds any internal gRPC this capability may later expose (ADR-0056/0105 zero-GraphQL, internal-only Protobuf); an omitted block would read as an unruled surface.

adrs.title: Closed Capability Registry And Deterministic Placement

sharding_automation.non_claim: A capability root of library crates has no tenant shards to split, merge or rebalance. Sharding automation is claimed by the absorbed services that actually run, in their own manifests; ADR-0348 automation is declared disabled here rather than omitted so the absence is a measured statement instead of a gap.

dr.non_claim: No runtime store, failover drill or DR evidence belongs to this capability root; DR is exercised by the absorbed services. `dr_tier` above is the inherited obligation, not a measured result.

foundation_non_claims: this manifest describes the 68 crates directly under iam/ and does NOT restate, aggregate or supersede the 3 absorbed service manifests listed above
no deployed process, served endpoint, measured benchmark, capacity telemetry or audit-chain writer is claimed for the capability root itself
slos_note: These OpenSLO files measure crates that live directly under this capability root and belong to no absorbed service manifest, so this root is their only manifest home.
